models.name: hub_documents
models.refSql: SELECT doc_version_id, doc_type, category, status::text AS status, effective_date, expiry_date, parse_quality FROM public.documents WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ('__COMPANY__' = 'ALL' OR ARRAY_POSITION(branch_scope, 'all') IS NOT NULL OR ARRAY_POSITION(branch_scope, '__BRANCH__') IS NOT NULL)

properties.description: Non-deleted document rows visible to the authorized company, including group-wide documents. Use COUNT(DISTINCT doc_version_id), not COUNT(*), for the canonical document total. No unique primary key is asserted.

models.name: hub_intake_batches
models.refSql: SELECT id, company_id, status::text AS status, total_files, created_at FROM public.hr_intake_batches WHERE ('__COMPANY__' = 'ALL' OR company_id = '__COMPANY__')

properties.description: One intake batch. Sum total_files for uploaded file volume. A completed batch is not proof of successful staging conversion. Failure rate and processing duration are not supported by this model.

models.name: hub_staged_records
models.refSql: SELECT id, batch_id, company_id, staging_status::text AS staging_status, suspected_duplicate, created_at FROM public.hr_employee_staging WHERE ('__COMPANY__' = 'ALL' OR company_id = '__COMPANY__')

properties.description: One staged HR record, scoped by the record's company. Not an employee master/headcount table. A suspected duplicate is a flag, not a confirmed duplicate. This model exposes no employee name, citizen ID, email, phone or salary.
